actual_scope: For exactly four restored dirty scalar roles over F2[S4], determine whether a fourth role enables a three-paid-call implementation of diag([a],[b],[e],[e]) for every ordered noncommuting pair a,b in {s1*s2,s2*s1,s2*s3,s3*s2}, using every rank-one idempotent in M4(F2) and the three adjacent-transposition labels.

This refinement fixes four roles and exhausts the eight ordered pairs of distinct noncommuting two-letter 3-cycles, separating it from current three-role S4 work on identical 4-cycles and identical double transpositions.
bottleneck_link: A three-call identity would lower this abstract formal bit-mechanism invoice from four paid calls to three, a 25 percent saving before other charges. No physical supplier realization is established, so this gives no selected-moment or kappa change.
stop_rule: Enumerate the complete 360-factor alphabet through length three using all 129600 ordered pairs and all 2880 final-factor meets across the eight ordered noncommuting target pairs, verify all eight explicit four-call words and controls, then stop. Do not generalize to other register counts or address groups.
evidence: The registered exact verifier finds 87016 unique ordered-pair product matrices including identity; all 2880 target-side meets for eight ordered target pairs miss.
